_id: ISL rung: keepIslInPerAssetEkf. One crosslink change against golden_baseline_multi.json (G5S6R4 federated, four antennas per spacecraft); every other leaf is inherited. Crosslinks fed into each per-asset EKF as well as the relative layer. DELIBERATELY DOUBLE-COUNTS the observation -- the golden keeps this false precisely so the relative layer's covariance stays independently valid. This rung exists to measure the size of that violation, not to be used as a result.
